entry.title: Konopiště Castle

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: Inspected picture confirms the cream quadrangular castle, dominant round keep with corbelled upper gallery/red cone, red roofline and timber-cross corner rooms. Retained mapped outer/two-court rings and standard viewer PMTiles set approximate location, scale and south-terrace orientation. The original4.8m reconstructed court/terrace floor receives a0.6m working rise; bounded wall bottoms extend beneath the coarse sampled hill. Anchor 14.656541475,49.779576024; heading -0.117875714253; standard PMTiles datum 384.34631015663166m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
